bounded_question: How can Return / Service remain continuously recoverable without making the phone dominate the landscape?

alternatives.mechanism: persistent low-emphasis return/service rail with expandable recovery sheet
alternatives.benefit: one-step recovery from every content state
alternatives.risk: persistent chrome may compete with landscape-first attention

alternatives.mechanism: compact state-aware return beacon with service drawer
alternatives.benefit: minimal screen occupation while keeping recovery reachable
alternatives.risk: small control may be less discoverable under stress or low attention

alternatives.mechanism: explicit explore-to-return mode transition that suppresses optional content
alternatives.benefit: strongest semantic separation between exploration and recovery
alternatives.risk: adds a mode transition and may make users wonder how to leave return mode
